title: Woman found dead in jail cell
article: The Independent Investigations Office of B.C. has been called to investigate the in-custody death of a woman in a White Rock RCMP cell on Tuesday.
RCMP said the 58-year-old woman was arrested on Friday on an outstanding warrant and kept in custody to attend court on Tuesday.
At 10:38 a.m. the next morning, the woman was observed by a guard to be lying on the floor and unresponsive. Efforts to revive her were unsuccessful.
